source_audit_note: The original two-master cluster test lowers maxRegions to 3 and restores a four-region snapshot. The exact B3 check evaluated with namespace total=1, previous table regions=1, requested=4, max=3, threw QuotaExceededException, and the original JUnit passed because it expected RestoreSnapshotException with that cause. Identical target exceptions under faults are expected observations, not bugs.
elapsed_basis: Wall time from main original-JUnit healthy start through manifest calibration final log mtime; includes scheduling pauses and source review.
stopping_reason: Authorized 128 strict target-retaining trials reached; one conditional extension from 80, no further expansion.

manifest_supplement.source_review: Both real DistributedFileSystem.open IOException injections occur in SnapshotManifest.readDataManifest before RestoreSnapshotProcedure.prepareRestore calls checkAndUpdateNamespaceRegionQuota. The IOException propagates through SnapshotManifest.open; restore fails and the log reports successful rollback. The original JUnit then fails because its expected QuotaExceededException cause is absent. Exact B3 check is not reached after either fault, so both trials are excluded under the selected-target rule.

abandoned_initial_temporary_snapshot_cal.reason: The initial picker selected a temporary snapshot-creation manifest before the restore manifest. Stopped before completion; not counted as a fault trial.

source_review.original_junit_assertion: The test explicitly expects RestoreSnapshotException caused by QuotaExceededException and checks the namespace count remains one.
source_review.main_fault_outcome: All 128 strict target-retaining trials re-executed the exact guard, saw the expected quota exception and passed the unchanged original JUnit; zero unexpected target exceptions or post-target JUnit failures.
source_review.manifest_boundary: Two strict actual restore-manifest DFS.open IOException trials lost the target before the quota guard; test failures are excluded and do not prove a new bug.
source_review.instrumentation_provenance: Case-local runtime ByteBuddy target/ZK I/O probe, case-local DFS.open ByteBuddy supplement and JaCoCo coverage on original release JAR/test JAR; no GraphChecker skeleton, static map, graph or closure.

quality_completion_note: Original embedded two-master JUnit healthy seed and 128 distinct strict fault sequences retaining exact B3 were completed. A separate two-selector real manifest-file I/O calibration documented the target-loss boundary. Per-trial UTC time, identity, target/JUnit and production coverage are in work/trial_ledger.json; full checkpoint remains in work/checkpoint.json.
